---
title: "Explore the atlas"
title-block-style: none
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/explorer.css">
<header class="explore-head">
  <div>
    <h1>Explore reported dengue in Colombia</h1>
    <p>Compare recorded cases with the weeks that contributed data. The historical extract covers 2019–2022.</p>
  </div>
  <a href="methods.html" class="text-link">Methods</a>
</header>
<noscript><p class="notice">Enable JavaScript to explore the map. The <a href="figures.html">static figures</a> and <a href="data.html">source tables</a> are also available.</p></noscript>
<div id="app-error" class="notice" role="alert" hidden></div>
<div id="atlas" aria-busy="true">
  <section class="selection-summary" aria-labelledby="selection-heading">
    <div class="selection-intro">
      <div>
        <h2 id="selection-heading">Current selection</h2>
        <p id="selection" aria-live="polite">Loading the historical snapshot…</p>
      </div>
      <nav class="example-links" aria-label="Worked example for dengue, 2019">
        <span>Compare in 2019</span>
        <a href="?department=05&amp;event=210&amp;start=2019&amp;end=2019&amp;first=1&amp;last=52&amp;metric=rate">Antioquia</a>
        <a href="?department=11&amp;event=210&amp;start=2019&amp;end=2019&amp;first=1&amp;last=52&amp;metric=rate">Bogotá</a>
      </nav>
    </div>
    <dl class="selection-values">
      <div><dt>Recorded cases</dt><dd id="kpi-cases">—</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Department-weeks with records</dt><dd id="kpi-availability">—</dd></div>
      <div id="selected-rate" hidden><dt>Cases per 100,000 residents</dt><dd id="kpi-rate">—</dd></div>
    </dl>
    <p id="scope-note"></p>
  </section>

  <form id="filters" class="filters" aria-label="Atlas filters">
    <label>Geographic focus<select id="department"><option value="all">All departments</option></select></label>
    <label>INS event<select id="event"><option value="210">Dengue · 210</option><option value="220">Severe dengue · 220</option></select></label>
    <label>From year<select id="year-start"></select></label>
    <label>Through year<select id="year-end"></select></label>
    <label>Map measure<select id="metric"><option value="cases">Recorded cases</option><option value="rate">Per 100,000 residents</option></select></label>
    <button type="button" id="reset" class="secondary-button">Reset filters</button>
    <details class="week-options">
      <summary>Limit epidemiological weeks</summary>
      <div class="week-fields"><label>First week<input id="week-start" type="number" min="1" max="53" value="1"></label><label>Last week<input id="week-end" type="number" min="1" max="53" value="53"></label></div>
      <p>Only 2020 includes week 53.</p>
    </details>
  </form>
  <section class="availability-panel" aria-labelledby="availability-title">
    <h2 id="availability-title">How many weeks have source records?</h2>
    <p>Each bar counts the selected department-weeks with at least one source record. Hatching marks the share with no records.</p>
    <ul id="annual-availability"></ul>
  </section>
  <div class="map-layout">
    <section class="map-panel" aria-labelledby="map-title">
      <h2 id="map-title">Where Colombia recorded cases</h2>
      <p id="map-subtitle" class="chart-description"></p>
      <div id="map-container"></div><div id="map-legend" class="map-legend"></div>
      <div id="map-detail" class="map-detail" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <p class="source-note">The map uses generalized DANE boundaries. Select a department to update its weekly series and downloads. Bogotá stays hatched for both events because the extract contains no source rows there.</p>
    </section>
    <section class="ranking-panel" aria-labelledby="rank-title">
      <h2 id="rank-title">Departments by map value</h2>
      <p id="rank-description"></p><div id="rank-table"></div>
    </section>
  </div>
  <section class="chart-section" aria-labelledby="time-title">
    <h2 id="time-title">Weekly recorded cases</h2>
    <p id="time-description" class="chart-description"></p>
    <div id="timeline" class="plot" role="img" aria-labelledby="time-title" aria-describedby="time-description timeline-encoding"></div>
    <p class="source-note" id="timeline-encoding">Each point shows one week. A gap means no source rows. An open circle marks a weekly sum with records from only some of the selected departments.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="chart-section" aria-labelledby="season-title">
    <h2 id="season-title">Compare the same weeks across years</h2>
    <p id="season-description" class="chart-description"></p>
    <div id="seasonal" class="plot" role="img" aria-labelledby="season-title" aria-describedby="season-description season-encoding"></div>
    <p class="source-note" id="season-encoding">Yearly lines share a scale starting at zero. The source uses epidemiological weeks and only 2020 has a week 53.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="chart-section" aria-labelledby="table-title">
    <div class="table-heading">
      <h2 id="table-title">Cases and population by department and year</h2>
      <div class="download-actions"><button id="download" type="button">Download summary CSV</button><button id="download-weekly" type="button" class="secondary-button">Weekly values CSV</button></div>
    </div>
    <p id="table-description"></p>
    <div id="summary-table" class="table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable department-year summaries"></div>
    <p class="source-note">Cases sum the available records. Rates use each department’s total resident population for that year. The CSV leaves unavailable counts and rates blank and preserves any reported zero.</p>
    <details class="provenance">
      <summary>Sources and definitions</summary><div id="provenance-content"></div>
      <p><a href="data.html">Data and source register</a> · <a href="methods.html">Calculation methods</a></p>
    </details>
  </section>
</div>
<script src="assets/plotly.min.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="assets/atlas.js"></script>
```
